PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.

11. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
